from kfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from kfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from kfx.schema.message import Message

class Agent(Component):
    display_name = "Agent"
    inputs = [MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input"), MessageTextInput(name="session_id", display_name="Session", value="test-session")]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Response", name="response", method="response")]
    async def response(self):
        return Message(text="4")
